name: mirage
text: I checked the engine side and it looks steady. The last few passes listed 29 to 38 bets each, with no gaps, so the engine isn't what makes the list vanish. My best guess is the phone. It re-prices the listed bets against Novig every 15 seconds and drops any that are no longer +EV or have no seller at that price. The next engine list then puts them back. That is the same bug as your earlier 'no one was selling at that price' report. I fixed it for the CNO list, but that fix hasn't been released yet. The +EV list has the older fix. Can you tell me if this is the +EV tab or the CNO tab, and which app version you're on? I can then check whether this is the bug I know about or something new. Either way I'll put the fix in the next release.
